description: Regionale waterkeringen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dijken, dammen, stuwen en gemalen die zorgen dat ons land beschermd wordt tegen te hoog water. Regionale waterkeringen beschermen tegen water uit meren, kleine rivieren en kanalen. De provincie stelt op grond van de Waterwet de veiligheidsnormen vast voor de regionale waterkeringen. Daarnaast is de provincie ook toezichthouder op de regionale keringen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are dijken, hoogwaterbeheersing, provinciale-verordeningen, waterkeringen. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC, HTTPS://DATA.OVERHEID.NL/FORMAT/UNKNOWN. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
